main_text.p: 5.13.ut Tremell.reddit:In Reg.Et agitent vana. Partic. Pehil [Hebrew: פְּהִיל] Remotus, semotus, segregatus, absens, distans. Pahel [Hebrew: פְּרַק] Idem. Ithpehal [Hebrew: אִתְפְּרַק], [Syriac: ܐܬܦܪܩ] Servari, liberari, redimi: Rumpi, abrumpi, avelli, divelli, amoveri, dimoveri. Aphel Futur. [Hebrew: יַאפְּיקוּ] Ut discederet à me, 2.ad Cor.12.8.
[Hebrew: פְּרִיקָא, פְּרִיק] Ch. Redeptor, liberator, servator, vindex.
[Hebrew: פְּרוּקָא, פְּרוּק] Ch. [Syriac: ܦܪܘܩܐ] Syr. Idem. Plur. [Hebrew: פְּרוּקִין], Gen. 49.18. in Jonath.
[Hebrew: פּוּרְקָנָא, פּוּרְקָן] Ch. & Syr. Redemptio, liberatio, salus. Plur. [Hebrew: פּוּרְקָנִין, פּוּרְקַנְיָא], Psal.116.13.

[Hebrew: פְּרָקָא, פְּרָקַת] Ch. Compitum, bivium, ubi via disrumpitur, Obad.v.14. Item Cervix, Junctura cervicis, Compages vertebrarum cervicis: Articuli digitorum, manuum, pedum, ut Levit.14.25. Jon.

*[Hebrew: פְּרַקּ] Ch. Supinus in cervicem cadere. Ex Ithpehal [Hebrew: וְנָפַל מִן אֵימְתֵיהּ רְכָכֵיהּ מִתְפְּרְקִיר לַאֲחוֹרֵיהּ] Et cadit præ terrore ipsius, sessor ejus retrorsum. Nam pro [Hebrew: רְכָבֵיהּ] legendum [Hebrew: רְכָבֵיהּ], tum ratione sensus, tum ex Targum Hierosolymitano, Genef.49.17.in Jonath.
[Hebrew: פְּרִקְטוּנִין, פְּרִקְטָנִין] Ch. Piscinæ, Rivi, Alvei.

page.notes: Several Hebrew and Syriac words are rendered as placeholders in the Latin transcription above; the Hebrew vowel-pointed forms and the Syriac script are only approximated and should be checked against the scan. The Greek-letter and Hebrew forms in the first entries are uncertain. The catchword is absent; the page ends with the partial word "Para-".
